notes.title: Bug Fixes & Community Game Night
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/656389bf17dd026f2f1a8c0d7ebf0eb925182051.png"][/img][/p][h2]Hear, ye! Hear, ye! A News Post Doth Come![/h2][p][/p][h3]Necrofugitive Demo BugFixes[/h3][p]Over the last few weeks, we have become aware of bugs that exist within the Necrofugitive demo and routinely push hotfixes and updates to resolve them. One of our persistent bugs that seems to happen between these updates is a misalignment of hitboxes due to some niche quirks between the engine and our tools during export. Simply put, we are constantly tuned in for your bug reports (there's a SUBMIT REPORT button in game) so that we can fix these problems as they arise.[/p][p]Below is an itemized list of all of the changes in this latest build:[/p][list][*][p]Added missing knight transform animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Knight overhead attack now inflicts KNOCKDOWN instead of KNOCKBACK.[/p][/*][*][p]Restored missing hitboxes in footman shield guard animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blink ability not granting invincibility during use.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Card Roulette Action[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/40e6dc11fd6e6c9491cd206d4c09d680b71fd95b.png"][/img][/p][p]Our special promotional keys for DEAD MAN'S HAND: Card Roulette Action will be going out this week! Our team will be distributing them via [b]email[/b] to users who have backed the game at $25 or more. A second key will also be delivered to our VIP backers from the pre-campaign.[/p][p]The official distribution for the DMH keys begins[b] this Thursday, August 14th.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the success of our campaign and all the new players, we are hosting the very first Community Game Night that very same day! We are also adding an exclusive [b]Emblem of Skoroz Trigger Flair[/b] to DEAD MAN'S HAND, which is only available during the day of the key distribution. To unlock it, sign into the game at any on time on August 14th.[/p][p]We hope to see you there![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2858790/announcements/detail/530980289128694817"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]That's all for this update! If you have any questions about the game or the campaign, please be sure to leave them in the comments! We'll be checking back in with another update in the coming days. Thank you all once again for your continued support.
[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Necrofugitive Act 1 Successfully Funded on Kickstarter
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/3fdcff91010ff58b23763d10f7e091daf55bbcb7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Hear, ye! Hear, ye! A news post doth come![/h1][p][/p][p]After thirty days in the gauntlet of Kickstarter campaigning, we are pleased to announce that [b]Necrofugitive has officially been funded![/b] Thank you to each and every one of you who has contributed to the campaign.[/p][p]Now that we have concluded our campaign, we are very excited to announce a few things. Please read along for more information.[/p][p][/p][h2]Necrofugitive — Map of Avencia[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/a3e73b2878999f244df316bdf381395e5dbe5567.png"][/img][/p][p]We are very excited to share this regional map of Necrofugitive's Kingdom of Avencia. In the full version of Necrofugitive, we intend to make each of these regional areas accessible to players for their escapes. For now, we'd like to direct your attention to the Southwest corner of the continent— the Duchy of Castor.[/p][p][/p][h2]Act 1 - The Duchy of Castor & Fortress Havenhold[/h2][p]Necrofugitive's opening act will take place in a place called Fortress Havenhold, located on a remote plateau within the Duchy of Castor. Learn more about this region in the excerpt below.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/cceeea0dde961670f40ad6c5097741afa085443b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Forged in the fires of war and steadfast adherence to the Avencian Code of Arms, the Duchy of Castor sits in the southernmost region of Avencia. Tasked with generations of stalwart defense against threats from beyond her borders, the children of Castor know what it means to fortify, protect, and hold the line. Theirs is a harsh, obedient doctrine, where one's potential is not defined by the station of his birth, but his ability to obey orders and unflinchingly devote his entire being to the preservation of the Avencian way of life. With noble birth, high walls, well-trained hounds, and the zealous devotion of his troops, their duke's claim to the throne is most certainly irrefutable...[/i][/p][p]We will share more about the Duchy of Castor in a future update. Please stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][h2]It's Not Too Late — Late Pledges Accepted![/h2][p]For those who are late to the party, Kickstarter rolled out a feature called [b]Late Pledges[/b] that we are very excited to have learned about. With Late Pledges, the studio will be able to continue to accept pledges for the game even after the campaign is finished! This also includes contributing toward stretch goals, so keep the momentum going and we might just see something awesome happen.[/p][p]We will only be accepting late pledges for select tiers while supplies last and for a limited time, so don't hesitate to pull the trigger![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blackgarden/necrofugitivegame?ref=1qhj03" buttoncolor="#e10909"]Click Here to Visit the Kickstarter Page[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Backer-Exclusive Skins[/h2][p]As detailed in the campaign, we've got a handful of backer exclusive skins available for Necrofugitive. Below you can see not just the human form, but also the monster form of these exclusives. Be sure to take a look.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/05066d156a9a65f543487ac4ca74d6a7ce545ba2.png"][/img][/p][p]These skins are each included at different tier levels, with the full set of them included in all tiers priced at $75 and above. We hope you'll enjoy spreading your colors all across Avencia.[/p][h2]Survivor Mode[/h2][p]In addition to the content coming as part of the Necrofugitive campaign, our team is also creating a special game mode where players will need to fight to survive against waves of oncoming enemies. We will have more to share about this game mode in a future update.[/p][p][/p][h2]Localization[/h2][p]We are so thankful that Necrofugitive has been a game that can help bring players together all around the world. Included in the $50,000 level of funding is also localization for Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Brazilian Portuguese! As we have noted in the past, players from these three countries represent a sizable portion of the Necrofugitive Wishlists on Steam, so we are making sure to bring the game to these regions as quickly as possible.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/c7420a63fc46eab6ff14b95e90f1aa3f81cdd5be.png"][/img][/p][p]That's all for this update! If you have any questions about the game or the campaign, please be sure to leave them in the comments! We'll be checking back in with another update as the campaign continues. Thank you all once again for your continued support.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/76c86d48e91edc7e80fed69792c41b052934ca6d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Necrofugitive is 90% Funded on Kickstarter!
notes.content: [p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blackgarden/necrofugitivegame/posts/4433604"]This post is a mirror of a post from our Kickstarter campaign.[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/c7420a63fc46eab6ff14b95e90f1aa3f81cdd5be.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/53c28c21512fe247ad3ba4ae323e2f84a88528d2.png"][/img][/p][h1]Hear ye, Hear ye! A News Post Doth Come! [/h1][p]Necrofugitive is now [b]90% funded[/b] on Kickstarter! With under $5000 remaining to reach the goal, we are on the cusp of victory with your help! Please continue to share the project and help us to not only smash through the goal, but also bring the game to consoles sooner.[/p][p]Just 10 days remain. Show the world that you're as ready for Necrofugitive to finally be made as we are.[/p][p]We've outlined our plans for the development timeline of Necrofugitive on the main story page, but we'd like to revisit it once again in this update to review our plans for the game's production.[/p][p][/p][h1]Development Timeline[/h1][h1][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/d35e8fed6a4e76c51cfbada48b2a126a2332514c.png"][/img]As outlined in the above graphic, our plans for Necrofugitive's development, pending the success of the Kickstarter, are based around bringing players content within 2025. This begins with those who belong to our [b]Private Play-Test Group. [/b]These players will receive access to exclusive first-look builds of new areas and encounters that we are developing for the game. The first of these will release in Q3 of 2025. That means [b]sometime within the next 90 days [/b]if all things go to plan. It is not typical for videogame Kickstarters to deliver content to players so swiftly, but we are dedicated to getting the game made as quickly as we can. We want to likewise make sure that the content itself is fun. [/p][p]We wish to also draw your attention to the final note on the infographic: these timeline projections are based upon our funding levels, as well as platform limitations. Many console platforms do not provide early access options for titles, and even then, porting is its own process for each platform. We will be rolling things out as quickly as time permits, but likewise thank you for your patience in matters that are beyond our control to influence or change. [/p][p]If you wish to gain access to the Private Play-Test Group, it is available as an add-on when you back Necrofugitive. [b]It also comes included with all tiers priced $75 and above. [/b]It will also be distributed to all of our pre-campaign VIP supporters who have met the pledge requirements[b]. Even if your platform of choice is not on PC, we will still provide you with Private Play-Test access on PC while you wait for an official console release.[/b][/p][p]We will share more about our development timeline, which is subject to change based upon the level of funding received through the Kickstarter campaign.[/p][p][/p][h1]Community Spotlight[/h1][p][/p][p]For this installment of the Community Spotlight, we are giving a special shoutout to one of our most passionate fans, coming all the way from China. We speak of our dear friend [b]Katana Guy[/b]![/p][p]Katana Guy has been part of the Necrofugitive community for several years, and is by far one of our most vocal, dedicated players from the Chinese region. How dedicated? Katana Guy put together an entire guide in the Chinese language so that players overseas could play Necrofugitive for themselves, even without an official localization from our team. You can see the image below.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/56f8488c186c289580d8a657687b3e91edadcfb6.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]When putting together our Chinese version of the Necrofugitive Pre-Alpha gameplay trailer, Katana Guy was the one who helped us to confirm the content was accurate for Chinese viewers. [/p][p]That isn't all, though! Katana Guy has also impressed us many times in the past with incredible combo videos uploaded to our Discord. We truly, truly pity any Avencian archer who crosses paths with this raging demon, and have uploaded one of these brutal combo clips to demonstrate why.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ERDmIZS0VaA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We are blessed to have such a dedicated player in our community. Unfortunately, Kickstarter does not support Bili Bili embeds, so instead we will just attach a link to one of Katana Guy's many Necrofugitive videos on the platform. Be sure to check it out below.[/p][p][u][url="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1fSqPY1Edb/"]Katana Guy — Necrofugitive Trial Gameplay Footage[/url][/u][/p][p]Have your own Necrofugitive content you'd like to share with the team? Let us know on our Discord! Feel free to send a message to BlackGardenDev if you'd like to get it to us directly. You can also email us at team@blackgarden.games.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Quick Question[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Finally, for this update's Quick Question segment we'd like to ask you... [b]what new powers would you like to see added to the game?[/b][/p][p]Being a powerful shapeshifter, there are all sorts of amazing new ways you could potentially face down your foes and sneak toward freedom. We want to hear your ideas for some of them! [/p][p][i]A reminder for those backing the [b]Skilltree of Skoroz tier— [/b]your answer can be made a reality in the final game![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/c7420a63fc46eab6ff14b95e90f1aa3f81cdd5be.png"][/img]  [/p][p]That's all for this update! If you have any questions about the game or the campaign, please be sure to leave them in the comments! We'll be checking back in with another update as the campaign continues. Thank you all once again for your continued support.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/76c86d48e91edc7e80fed69792c41b052934ca6d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Necrofugitive is Coming to Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/638b2759f543fafb4416f5a2f03db1f9cc9d06e4.png[/img]

Hear ye, hear ye! A new Necrofugitive announcement doth come!

Greetings and salutations, dear friends. We, the team at Black Garden Studios, come bearing news and information about Necrofugitive! Let this issue of the Avencian Herald commence!

[h1]Necrofugitive is coming to Kickstarter![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/0ae454631f75fa45123527b8b4902a2bde81d6c7.png[/img]

notes.title: Necrofugitive 2024 Wrap Up — News & Announcements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/638b2759f543fafb4416f5a2f03db1f9cc9d06e4.png[/img]

Hear ye, hear ye! A new Necrofugitive announcement doth come!

Greetings and salutations, dear friends. We, the team at Black Garden Studios, come bearing news and information about Necrofugitive! Let this issue of the Avencian Herald commence!

[h3]The Paladin Draws Nearer![/h3]

Earlier this year we shared a first look at our newest enemy type, the Paladin. Paladins will be advanced enemies that challenge your skills as a player with their unflinching resolve and towering shields. The presence of a Paladin on the battlefield is sure to raise the morale of friendly troops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/1363bd45df5a6192985fbb62bdd019c6626ae1d5.gif[/img]

Just what is the holy order these brave knights belong to? Stay tuned to learn more.

[h3]New Unit Type — Political Prisoners
[/h3]

Along with a second look at the Paladin, we’re also happy to introduce another new unit type— the Political Prisoner! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/1d8575de71dd754df8ea1f95326cfd34b74f05e6.gif[/img]

Most often born to the common folk and peasantry, these individuals find themselves in a situation much like the titular Necrofugitive prisoner. With their future hanging in the uncertain hands of a tyrannical kingdom, their allegiances lie with no one but themselves. Happening across such an individual opens an interesting opportunity for interaction.

Will you set them free and let them serve as a distraction? Will you prey upon them to bolster your own abilities? Or will you simply choose to ignore their plight and leave them to their fate? Choices like these are a critical element of the Necrofugitive experience.

[h3]Tech Demo - The Centurion Conflict[/h3]

Among the many updates made this year include optimizations to the game’s code to improve performance. We’ve prepared a video to highlight these new changes and give you a brief glimpse into the world of Necrofugitive beyond the role of the game’s protagonist. Taking place during the Avencian Civil War, the Centurion Conflict Tech Demo features at least 100 active combatants on each side fighting in a pitched skirmish to claim the plains of Avencia. Please take a look at the video showcase below.

[previewyoutube=8XHzlwiNggA;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see in the video above, we are proud to confirm Necrofugitive can support large scale conflicts in the midst of normal gameplay without compromising performance. This includes not only soldiers battling in the field of play, but also additional skirmishers in the distance along the horizon. We also would like to point out that each soldier on screen has their own independent AI behaviors and personalities processing simultaneously all throughout the conflict. This should give a sense of scale for the experience we wish to give players as they claw their way toward freedom.

The Avencian Civil War plays a large role in the story of Necrofugitive. Just why is the nation divided, and who are the factions at play? Stay tuned for a future post diving more into the conflict and those taking up arms in it.

[h3]Black Garden Studios is Looking for an Environment Artist
[/h3]

As we ramp up Necrofugitive development, the team at Black Garden is currently on the lookout for an environment artist to join the Necrofugitive project. 

With that said, we are also not opposed to sourcing environment assets from various different artists, rather than bringing on a single dedicated artist. Things like boulders and bushes, trees and guillotines, the limits lie in your imagination. The most important thing is that the asset must be consistent with the pixel art style of the game.

For artists looking for a very low-stakes opportunity to, at minimum, get their name in the credits of Necrofugitive, this is also a great chance to get a taste of the game development experience without the commitment and expectations of a formal hire.

If you are interested in submitting your work for consideration, please send an email to [b]art@blackgarden.games[/b] with the subject line “Environment Artist”, your portfolio, and a little bit of information about yourself, your availability, and the level of involvement you are interested in should you be selected.

[h3]International Localization Plans — Translator Recruitment
[/h3]

Our team is incredibly thankful to be able to say Necrofugitive has many fans across the world. As we receive our reviews, reports and feedback from players, we notice quite a few of these reports are in languages beyond just English. As a small independent team, we have had to rely on limited resources, including machine translation, to attempt to offer some degree of support beyond the English language. With this said, we are not satisfied with the current state of things and wish to recruit those who can provide the proper localizations our players deserve.

While we are interested in hearing from speakers and translators of all languages, we have also noticed that Chinese speaking players are among our largest player base. For this reason, our team is looking for Chinese localization in particular to help us better respond to the needs of this very large group of players.

As mentioned before, though Chinese language support is the most urgent of our localization needs, we have a strong desire to provide localization support in as many languages as possible. If you are a person who can assist us with this need, please reach out to [b]localization@blackgarden.games[/b] with your information, including rates, languages, experience, and level of familiarity with Necrofugitive. Include subject line "LOCALIZATION - [Language]" with your specific languages in the brackets.

Even if you have not done formal, professional localization work in the past, if you are a passionate fan who wants to contribute to the Necrofugitive project in this special and important way, we would love to hear from you. Please send us an email.

[h3]Other Black Garden Projects — DEAD MAN’S HAND: Card Roulette Action
[/h3]

As mentioned in our last Necrofugitive update, our team is still also providing steady content support for our other title, DEAD MAN’S HAND: Card Roulette Action.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35905874/6aef9ca8fc91bdfc4b51ab21d2a31d73f0c2c727.png[/img]

In addition to new unlockables added in regular intervals, the game has now featured two seasonal events (one of them ongoing at the time of this post), improvements to the UI, guest player slots, bounties, web browser & mobile support, and more. While it is not Necrofugitive, we are very proud of what we have achieved with this project, and as always, would like to remind you that each sale of DEAD MAN’S HAND helps to support the continued operation of our studio, and the development of Necrofugitive.

The game is currently seeing a steep discount as part of the Steam Winter Sale, costing only $2.50 at time of writing. If you’re looking for a quick gift for friends that won’t set you back, please consider buying our game.

[h3]Support Black Garden Studios — Patreon, Ko-fi, & PayPal
[/h3]

We have been tremendously blessed to have fans of Black Garden Studios reach out and ask how they can give donations or further support our studio. In response to this, we are launching three different ways for fans to contribute. For those who wish to make a monthly contribution, we have the Patreon & Ko-fi options. For those who wish to make one time contributions, you can donate directly via PayPal.

Regardless of your choice, we are tremendously grateful for all support, paid or otherwise. We will be offering exclusive rewards such as flairs for DEAD MAN’S HAND and copies of our games as thanks.

If you would like to check out any of our donation pages, please visit the links below:

[h2][url=https://www.patreon.com/c/BlackGardenStudios]Patreon[/url] | [url=https://ko-fi.com/blackgardenstudios]Ko-fi[/url] | [url=https://www.paypal.com/biz/profile/blackgardenstudios]PayPal[/url][/h2]

[h3]When Will Necrofugitive Release?
[/h3]

Unsurprisingly, one of the most frequent questions we get from players is when Necrofugitive will be releasing. At this time, the Necrofugitive team does not have a formal release date to share. While development has remained steady and ongoing through the year, we have likewise still continued to develop the game when able, rather than full time. We are optimistic, based on developments behind the scenes, that this will begin to change in the coming year after certain goals and benchmarks are met.

We thank you for your continued patience, and hope to have more information to share in 2025. Until then, we thank you once more for all of the support, well wishes, and kind words you have shared with us since this journey began. We are committed to getting Necrofugitive into your hands as soon as we can, and want to make sure that when you get it, you’ll love every second of the action, tension, and excitement in your sprint toward freedom.

Until next time, this is the team at Black Garden Studios wishing you a happy new year. We’ll see you then.

notes.title: Necrofugitive April 2024 News Update + DEAD MAN'S HAND Launch
notes.content:
Hear ye, hear ye! A Necrofugitive news announcement doth come!

Greetings and salutations, dear friends. This is your friends over at Black Garden Studios with additional news and information about Necrofugitive and the latest other projects from our studio!

First and foremost, we thank you for your continued support over the days, weeks and months, and hope you will continue to enjoy playing the Necrofugitive demo and all it has to offer. As we continue to develop the title, it brings us great joy to hear your feedback and see your content online, be it a playthrough or article related to the game.

As for the game itself, today we are excited to share a new character that you will encounter during your exodus from the realm of your oppressors. Before we get too much into the nitty gritty of it all, it is only fair that we give a small spoiler warning. Those who wish to experience Necrofugitive blind without any external knowledge should skip the following section. With that all said…

[h2]A New Enemy Unit Draws Near![/h2]

Veteran players of the Necrofugitive demo may already be somewhat familiarized with the morale and fear systems that we have in play. The horrors and chaos of the prisoner’s escape does much to strike fear into the hearts of soldiers just as swiftly as dwindling morale will cause them to turn heel and flee for their lives. Joining the kingdom’s forces is a special unit that knows no fear. 

[h3]Meet the Paladin.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/fe427d20332b5134f020c10e466cf32371a8713a.png[/img]

The Paladin is a special unit type that we have heard mentioned and requested by name across the years from our players, and one that we are excited to finally reveal. As implied by the previous passage, the Paladin’s got a few unique qualities that set him apart from his comrades. First and foremost is an unwavering devotion to his cause. While most units can be scared into submission, the Paladin is unflinching. Conviction and fortitude drive his every move, and that translates into a morale boost for his comrades as well.

In his arsenal, the Paladin employs a great shield that can protect himself and others from harm, allowing him and his allies to advance safely. You’ll find his tenacity to be both inspiring and frustrating to contend with. Please look forward to meeting him in Necrofugitive.

We’ll have more information to share about the title at a later time.

[h1]Game Release — DEAD MAN’S HAND: Card Roulette Action Available Now![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35905874/a5a607cd845ca86db0fb8419873221af4976d7a7.png[/img]

For those of you keeping up with our latest updates, you may have heard that Black Garden Studios has been working on another title as well.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2858790/DEAD_MANS_HAND_Card_Roulette_Action/]DEAD MAN’S HAND: Card Roulette Action[/url] is a 2-8 player online multiplayer title that combines Russian roulette with the unpredictable nature of card games. Mixing elements of Steampunk, Dystopian-Cyberpunk and robotic gamblers with revolvers and playing cards, we’re confident that this title will give you and your friends something to talk about.

As mentioned in our previous update, we began working on this game so that its release could help generate additional funding to work on Necrofugitive. That means every single sale brings us that much closer to being able to work on game development full-time.

We will be supporting [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2858790/DEAD_MANS_HAND_Card_Roulette_Action/]DEAD MAN’S HAND: Card Roulette Action[/url] with free content updates over time depending on the overall sales of the game, so be sure to throw your hat in the ring. If you were looking for a way to support the studio, this is your chance. It costs only $5, so don’t be shy about getting a copy for your friends as well.

That's all for this update! Thanks for reading and continuing to support the team over at Black Garden. We'll be checking in again with more news and announcements in the future, so be sure to stay tuned.

notes.title: Announcing DEAD MAN'S HAND: Card Roulette Action
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2858790/DEAD_MANS_HAND_Card_Roulette_Action/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2858790/extras/lineup2_1.gif?t=1710095003[/img][/url]

As we continue working on Necrofugitive, we find ourselves experimenting with various ideas and concepts that turn out pretty fun on their own. Sometimes, those concepts turn into entirely new creations. 

With that in mind, our team is proud to announce the existence of a secret project, and we want you, the community that has been on this journey with us, to take part in it. We’ll be conducting a playtest of a brand new title in the near future, and we want members of this community to be some of the first to get their hands on it.

[h2]Introducing DEAD MAN'S HAND: Card Roulette Action[/h2]

As some of you may know, Necrofugitive is an indie-title without a publisher, and if you’ve been paying attention to the news, the videogame industry is crumbling under the weight of layoffs, losses, and general malaise. Full transparency, making videogames is our passion and dream, but without consistent funding it is hard for our team to work full time on Necrofugitive. In 2023 we met several publishers that were interested in funding our game, but ultimately many of them suffered the same problem— they no longer had the kind of money needed to take on new projects like ours. Now that we finally see the truth of the matter in the news, with studios being shut down and major brands posting unprecedented losses, we finally know why.

Rather than let ourselves be held back by the industry’s problems, we have decided to take matters into our own hands. 

[h3]We have created a brand new game.[/h3]

Once this new project is released, we are eagerly hoping to see sales help us fund the continued development of Necrofugitive and allow our team to transition to full-time game development. With that being said, we want you, the members of our community, to be the first people to try it out with our first ever play-test.

Players will be able to sign up for the play test period through Steam in the near future, so please stay tuned for our next announcement.

[b]When will the new project be released?[/b]
You won’t be waiting long. We’ll be releasing the new game on April 8th, 2024 at high noon during the solar eclipse. Please look forward to it!

[b]What does this mean for Necrofugitive?[/b]
Worry not, dear friends. Necrofugitive is still in development. In fact, the more success we have with the new title, the faster we’ll be able to get Necrofugitive made. Players will not only get to help us fund Necrofugitive, but they’ll also get a fun new game in the process. 

[b][i]As always, please Wishlist the title on Steam![/i][/b]

notes.title: Christmas Demo Update
notes.content:
Tracking hounds have been added to the demo. You can find them in the forest searching for you after an alarm has gone off. It is possible to shapeshift into one of the dogs. Try barking at a guard to get him to follow you or open a door for you. Guards may find it suspicious that a dog knows how to open and close doors.

Guards can also now become suspicious of each other and even attack each other if provoked. See if you can start a fight among them about who the real traitor is!

notes.title: Necrofugitive Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hear ye, hear ye! A new update for the Necrofugitive Demo has arrived!

Over the past month the Necrofugitive team stealth dropped a new build of our vertical slice pre-alpha demo. This update features balance adjustments, new abilities, and a handful of fun and unexpected surprises. 

We have been paying close attention to your continued feedback across various platforms and through our feedback tool within the demo build itself. Based on this feedback, adjustments have been made to various attributes of the game in relation to resource management such as health and stamina, hit detection on corners and ledges, enemy placement, and overall game balance.

Another note we would like to share with players is that our enemies do not share a single mind. What that means is, being detected by one does not mean others will know you are there. Only when the alarms are raised will enemies across the map react to your presence. Being detected does not mean you are no longer able to hide, especially if you make the enemies who noticed you disappear before they could spread the word. This intelligent AI is one of our most notable features, so we hope you’ll keep it in mind as you play.

Now that we’ve covered the basics, let’s talk about some specific new features now found in the demo! 

=New Abilities=
Prisoner Tree - Slide Tackle
Knock your foes to the ground and lower your profile to slide by oncoming obstacles and closing gates.

Prisoner Tree - Rift Tendril
A powerful trap that sprouts tendrils from the underworld to ambush enemies. The tendril assimilates those who perish near it and converts their flesh into consumable health.

Monster Tree - Leviathan Form
An eldritch nightmare given form! Grow tendrils from your back that whip and punish your foes.

=Updated Abilities=
Prisoner Tree - Doppelganger
Spawn a living copy of yourself to fight by your side and distract your enemies. The copy may now be reintegrated into your flesh by approaching and pressing the assigned button.

Prisoner Tree - Tendril Yank
The tendril yank now has grappling hook properties. Sling your way across the map by latching onto environments and ledges to expand your mobility! As always, the ability can also latch onto enemies and give them a yank.

=Saved Progress - Demo Save File=

Players who wish to fight on with their current effort through the three stages of our demo can now select Continue from the main menu when starting their session. This will place you at the start of the stage you last reached and retains the skills you purchased after clearing previous levels.

=General Tips=
For those struggling to overcome your playthrough of the demo, we have some additional tips to help you along.

Remember the Goal - ESCAPE!
Your main objective will always be displayed at the top of the screen. Unless otherwise indicated, that objective is always one thing: ESCAPE. Standing and fighting is not always the solution. Sometimes, it is best to simply keep moving and flee before you are slain.

Try a New Build
As detailed above, there are many combinations of builds you can make with your skill points. If your current build is not cutting it, return to the main menu and restart the demo.

Patience is a Virtue
Guards move in various patterns and formations. Wait for the right moment to strike- or not strike- before making your move.

Keep An Eye On Your Meters
Disguises break when you’re out of Stamina. Don’t let that happen in front of guards. Armor is the only thing keeping your health from dropping on hit, so keep it active! Remember that your abilities are tied to your Energy and Stamina, don’t be stuck without any when you need it. Keep an eye on your meters!


=Player Expression - Discover Your Build!=

Necrofugitive is all about forging your own path and overcoming the challenges in your own way. There is no single definitive way to clear these challenges, leaving room for player expression and freedom at the forefront of the gameplay experience. If you find that your current build is not up to the task, we suggest a fresh restart of the demo so you can re-assign your skill points into new combinations.

Some powerful examples of some existing builds include:

Hunter-Stalker
Focus all of your skill points on the prisoner’s stealth and agility trees to create a fast moving, highly lethal, and most of all, highly evasive prisoner that can weave through enemy formations and take out chosen targets.

Monster Madness
Focus your skill points on abilities pertaining to summoning ravagers on the monster form skill tree. As your own army grows, face down your foes man to man and overwhelm them.

The Juggernaut
High AP and armor regeneration skill nodes are the key to this build. With constant resource generation on hit along with the Mass Assimilation ability, turn your monster form into an unkillable tyrant.

Tendril Base Builder
Lure unsuspecting foes into a fortified nightmare as you lay down several Tendril Rifts and guide them to their doom. The tendrils serve as both ramparts and murder mills as they passively provide health pickups. Compound this with abilities such as Tendril Lash and Tendril Yank to whip and pull your foes to their end.

Me, Myself and I
Rely on your Doppelganger as an extension of your main assault arsenal and always keep a friend nearby. Deadly positioning will leave your enemies at your mercy, while shapeshifting allows you to escape as your copy takes their focus.

= A Dog Eat Dog World =

Thank you to everyone for your continued support of Necrofugitive. Our team remains hard at work every week to bring the game closer to our shared vision, and 

As a final treat for the season, we’re excited to share one final update. We are pleased to announce that we are finally letting the dogs out— the Hound enemy type is almost ready to bare its fangs! Keep an eye out for it in the next few days; it will certainly be keeping its eyes out for you.

That’s all for now! Stay tuned for further updates in the coming months, and as always, keep on running!

—Team Necro

notes.title: 2022 Necrofugitive Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have some exciting news to share! A little over a year ago, we released a combat and stealth demo in order to gather feedback about how we should proceed. I'm happy to share that once again that we have finished a vastly new and improved demo, which you can download from our store page. This demo features a full 3-stage campaign, a customizable skill tree, improved AI and bug fixing, voice acting, a new soundtrack, a slew of combat and stealth improvements, and more!

This is our last demo we will release before releasing the full game on Steam and other platforms. This demo will always be available, primarily because feedback is valuable! If you played the demo and want to send us your thoughts, we've set up a [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc4HKrg5jENmtNn3j8Ed3OroDGrT09T4Y-CTcyCvKRXxu56hQ/viewform]survey[/url] for your convenience.

Additionally, Necrofugitive is currently being featured in Steam Next Fest until October 10th. This means we will be broadcasting gameplay and commentary over the week so we can explain more about Necrofugitive and how development is going! See you all soon!

[i]Team Black Garden[/i]

notes.title: Necrofugitive Stealth Demo is Now Available!
notes.content:
We've finished a [url=https://blackgardenstudios.itch.io/necrofugitive-demo]brand new stealth demo[/url], loaded with a slew of new gameplay mechanics and a new stage featuring a prison fortress swarming with armed patrols. New abilities have been added, most notably the ability to assimilate and shapeshift into enemy soldiers! Can you outwit your enemies, escape Havenhold Prison, and secure your freedom?

A full list of included features:

 [list]
[*]     Assimilate and Shapeshift: absorb enemy corpses and disguise yourself as one of them!
[*]     Execute: a new heavy attack that can instantly kill enemies knocked down!
[*]     New Seek and Destroy AI: AI soldiers have been reworked to hunt you down based on sound cues, line of sight, illumination, guard voices, and alarms.
[*]     Stealth Kills: the prisoner can now instantly kill unaware guards with a deadly backstab
[*]     Wardens: A new enemy type, Wardens are imposing and dangerous enemy type that carry lanterns and crossbows, fully capable of taking you on in a one-on-one fight. Be extremely cautious around them!
[*]     Havenhold Prison: an expansive new stage featuring a ruined fortress converted into a prison
[/list]

Don't forget to join us on [url=https://twitter.com/BlackGardendev]Twitter[/url] and [url=http://discordapp.com/invite/HeHApvW]Discord[/url] to keep up to date with more development news!
